d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, aaj Tirupati Mandir wali style me Boondi ke laddu ki recipe banayenge, ye bhai ekdam mast bante hai aur sabse aasan tarika hai bundi ke laddo banane ka kyuki agar boondi ya chasni me kuch 19-20 ho jae, fir bhi super bante hai...
Boondi Laddu Recipe :
250g Besan / 2 cups
1 cup Milk
1/2 cup Water
Food color
Baking Soda 1/8 tsp (use 1/4 tsp if besan is old)
Ghee or Oil - for frying
